description: Commission of Elections - Amendment to the Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2055/33 of 24.01.2018 (Western Provincial Council)
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Western Province Provincial Council due to a resignation. It involves the electoral process, including the notification of a vacancy, nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration by the Election Commission of a newly elected member. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
